items.title: Russell Brand prison message denying rape 'appalling' and being investigated, No 10 says
items.summary: The victims' commissioner for London says the message, broadcast by Brand's wife on their YouTube show, will "certainly retraumatise his victims".

items.title: Man jailed for life for attempted murder of children that sparked Dublin riots
items.summary: A man who attempted to murder three children - including stabbing one in the heart - as they waited outside their school in Dublin has been sentenced to life in prison.

items.title: Create more jobs for under-25s by cutting National Insurance, key report urges
items.summary: Some parents are so desperate for their children to find a job that they've offered to pay their wages, one hairdresser has told the BBC.

items.title: Snow warning for large part of the UK
items.summary: A yellow warning for snow and travel disruption has been issued across a large part of the UK by the Met Office.

items.title: UK lost more than it gained from Brexit, Burnham to say ahead of EU summit
items.summary: The prime minister will say the "Brexit we were given has not worked" in a speech on Monday.

items.title: Depardieu drops appeal against sexual assault conviction and apologises
items.summary: French actor Gerard Depardieu has withdrawn his appeal against a conviction for sexual assault and offered the "most sincere apologies" to his victims.
